summary.description:
Today, cooler for the feels like temperature (down 2.4°C), outside temperature (down 2.3°C), and inside temperature (down 2.0°C) and more moisture-laden outside humidity (up 6%).

Compared to today, yesterday also had noticeable differences in cloud levels (up 572 m).

The past week and month had observable variation in cloud levels (up 975 m) and light levels (up 5009 lux) when compared to today.
